snippet.title: Hyperlane Highway Storefront Trailer | Next Fest Demo
snippet.description:
VR Hoverboard Roguelike endless runner where you physically lean your head to dodge and steer and fight through teh galaxies hyperlanes. No thumbstick movement needed.

You can now wishlist on meta quest: 
Wishlist on Steam: store.steampowered.com/app/4514880/Hyperlane_Highway/

Built solo over 2 years with new style of VR first movement, deep card upgrade system, corporate sponsors, enemy waves and environments that get faster the better you play.

Coming to Steam Early Access and Meta Quest.

#HyperlaneHighway #VRGaming #IndieGame #VRRoguelike #MetaQuest
